proof_certificate.anchor_step: The left anchor b(0)=0 is a node-potential gauge choice in C0, not a C1 edge cochain and not an H^1 quotient class.
proof_certificate.audited_pattern_step: The audited path plus forced closing bit has parity 0 and is exact, so it represents the zero H^1 class rather than the generator.
proof_certificate.cycle_step: On the closed 12-cycle, rank(delta)=11 and dim C1=12, so C1/im(delta) has dimension 1.
proof_certificate.generator_step: The single closing-edge cochain 11->0 has odd parity, is not a coboundary, and is therefore a valid generator representative; any other single edge differs from it by an exact even-parity cochain.
proof_certificate.parity_step: Every coboundary has even total cycle parity; the image has 2^11 vectors, matching the even-parity kernel, so odd parity represents the nonzero H^1 class.
proof_certificate.path_step: On the open path, rank(delta)=11=dim C1, so H^1(path;GF(2))=0; b(0)=0 only fixes the constant C0 kernel.
proof_certificate.theoretical_limit: This locates the type and representative of the closed-cycle obstruction only; it does not derive the selector/source bit from nadsoliton dynamics, beta_tors, SSB, observer readout, or any bridge theorem.
